document_title: Understand common issues in Jira Service Management Cloud
content:
More reasons and detailed information can be found in the documentation below:
- Known problems with viewing requests on the customer portal
- Managing customer and approver access in Jira Service Management
A Jira administrator is unable to configure the Service space
In order to manage a Service space, the requirements are:
- Have a Jira Service Management license.
- Have Jira administrator permission.
- Be listed as an Administrator via Space settings > Access > People and access. 
  - Note that the Administrator role must also have Service Space Agent permission.
Related documentation:
- Standard permissions in Jira Service Management
- Configure projects
- Collaboration between Jira teams
- Overview of Jira Cloud permissions
A user was added to the Service Desk Team role, but once they log in, they are redirected to the Customer Portal
Adding a user without product access to the Service Desk Team role via Space settings > People will not allow them to view the space internally. A Service Management agent is a combination of a Service Management license and the Service Desk Team role.
Also, adding a Jira Software user to the Service Desk Team role won't allow them to act as agents; they will need a license.
The assignee of a ticket can’t see the ticket in the portal
An assignee can only view a ticket in the portal by clicking on View request in portal directly on a ticket.
Accessing the Customer Portal and clicking on Requests won’t show tickets assigned to an agent.
As mentioned in the first topic of this documentation, only the Reporter, request participants, and members of the Organization to which the ticket was shared can view requests when accessing the portal. The assignee can only access the ticket via the direct link on the internal tickets.
The ticket doesn't transition when the agent or customer adds a comment
In Legacy automation and Automation, it’s possible to create a rule that transitions tickets from Waiting for Support to Waiting for Customer, and vice versa, when a comment is added.
Sometimes, this rule won’t transition work items, and the most common cause is the Assignee also being listed as a Customer role. This means the Assignee is listed as a Request participant or member of an Organization the ticket was shared with.
To prevent these permission issues, ensure the Assignee is not added as a Participant or to Organizations.
If other agents need to receive notifications or collaborate on a ticket, they can set themselves as Watchers.
Other than issues with the Automation, adding an Agent as a Participant or Member of an Org can affect SLAs.
A Jira and Space administrator can’t view Queues, Reports, and other options on the space sidebar
When adding a new Org, Site, and Jira administrator, depending on the Product access settings, a Jira Service Management license is not automatically granted.
